description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a sign-up screen supporting phone OTP verification and password-based registration. It manages user input, validation, API interactions, and UI states.

classes.name: SignupScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the user registration screen supporting OTP and password registration methods.

classes.name: _SignupScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the logic and UI for the SignupScreen widget, including form handling, API calls, and user interaction states.

methods.name: _requestOtp
methods.description: Handles requesting an OTP by validating inputs, enforcing limits, and invoking the API.

methods.name: _verifyOtpAndCreate
methods.description: Verifies the entered OTP, manages verification failure counts, and proceeds with account creation.

methods.name: _signupWithPassword
methods.description: Handles sign-up via password, validating inputs and calling the backend API.
